content:
The leaves show a dense, white-to-gray powdery coating covering the entire leaf surface — classic white mycelial/sporulation growth on the upper leaf surface. The texture is clearly fuzzy/dusty white, spreading across multiple leaves uniformly.

This is textbook **Powdery Mildew** — the white powdery fungal growth (mycelium and conidia) covering the leaf surface is the defining symptom. Downy mildew would show growth on the underside and yellowing on the upper surface, not this uniform white coating.
